name: Improved Shadow’s Chill
body:
Improved Shadow’s Chill (Su)
Source Blood of Shadows pg. 9
When a rogue with this talent hits a creature with a melee weapon that deals sneak attack damage, the sneak attack damage is cold damage. Normal weapon damage is unaffected. The rogue must have cold resistance from a racial trait and the shadow’s chill rogue talent before choosing this talent.
